info.name: ft_transcendence | WAF Security Evaluation (Validated Demo v2)
info.description: Local-only WAF evaluation collection, revised from observed Postman responses on 2026-11-17. The original 32 probes returned: 22 x HTTP 403, 5 x HTTP 200, 2 x HTTP 400, 1 x HTTP 404, 1 x HTTP 405, 1 x HTTP 308. A new real-SID Engine.IO POST is an additional exploratory request, not yet verified. Enable TLS certificate verification and trust the local mkcert CA. Run requests in order. HTTP 403 alone is not proof of a particular ModSecurity rule: corroborate with CRS audit/error logs. SQLi, XSS, path traversal, command injection and other probes test suspicious patterns on a health endpoint; they DO NOT prove that those vulnerabilities exist in the application. Do not run outside an authorized local development environment. Some requests were previously double-URL-encoded by Postman; this revision stores decoded query values for Postman to encode once where possible, and requires one new live runner validation. The new 08.1b request is the sole added test; original controls remain present.

item.name: 08 — Engine.IO / Socket.IO scoped CRS exception
item.description: Expected application outcomes may be 400/401 because intentionally invalid or missing auth/sid. For GET and POST with valid polling Content-Type, the narrow CRS 920420 exception must keep WAF from returning 403. Do not confuse this with a successful authenticated Socket.IO connection.

item.name: 08.1 — Engine.IO polling handshake (observed 200; save live SID)

request.description: Engine.IO open packet (HTTP 200) is the transport handshake, not an authenticated Socket.IO namespace session. The Postman test stores its short-lived SID for the immediately following optional live POST. For true WebSocket/Socket.IO upgrade and message exchange, use a separate Postman Socket.IO request in the UI; plain HTTP requests in this collection are not WebSocket frames.

exec: pm.test("Engine.IO returns HTTP 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Engine.IO open packet contains a real SID", function () { const raw = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(raw.charAt(0)).to.equal("0"); const handshake = JSON.parse(raw.slice(1)); pm.expect(handshake.sid).to.be.a("string").and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set("engineio_sid", handshake.sid); });

item.name: 08.1b — Live Engine.IO polling POST with captured SID (EXPLORATORY)

request.description: New positive-control transport test, NOT yet verified on the real WAF. Run 08.1 immediately before this request to capture a fresh SID. A successful Engine.IO HTTP POST typically returns HTTP 200 and body ok, even if subsequent Socket.IO authentication rejects the namespace connection. A 400 may mean the transient SID expired or the namespace/backend closed it. If this test fails, inspect the transport response and rerun 08.1 rather than broadening the CRS exclusion.

exec: pm.test("Live Engine.IO polling POST succeeds (exploratory)", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Engine.IO replied ok, not WAF 403", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.equal("ok"); });

item.name: 08.2 — Invalid SID reaches Engine.IO (observed 400, not WAF 403)

request.description: Invalid sid is intentional. Backend may respond 400. Tests WAF 920420 exception with Content-Type text/plain.

exec: pm.test("Engine.IO rejected unknown SID with HTTP 400", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });
pm.test("Error originates from Engine.IO rather than WAF", function () { const obj = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(obj.code).to.equal(1); pm.expect(obj.message).to.equal("Session ID unknown"); });

item.name: 09 — Optional: HTTP redirect (port 8080)
item.description: Requires port 8080 to be accessible from the Postman machine; VS Code may forward only 8443. Skip this folder if 8080 is not forwarded. Postman redirect following is disabled on this request.

request.description: Expected 308 with Location https://transcendence.test:8443/. Follow redirects disabled on this request. If no connection, forward local 8080 via VS Code Ports.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 308 redirect to HTTPS", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(308); });
pm.test("Location points to local HTTPS", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location") || "").to.include("https://transcendence.test:8443/"); });
